0022600164.text: The Kings are 0-6, have lost six straight, and sit 15th in the West, 4 games back in the Pacific. They are without Ben Simmons (Achilles surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), Keegan Murray (ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee), and Zach LaVine is a game-time decision with an elbow injury. Dallas is 4-2 and riding a three-game win streak, sitting 6th in the West and 2 games back in the Southwest, but it is missing Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Santi Aldama (knee surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), while Kyrie Irving is a game-time decision with a knee issue. The teams have not played each other yet this season, and Sacramento won their most recent meeting 130-121 in Dallas, part of a 2-1 Kings edge in the 2025-26 season series.
